dailyChallenge.question: Which of these is the best definition of "Chatbot"?
choices: A defined way for one piece of software to request information or services from another, like a menu of actions one program offers to others.
A software program designed to hold a conversation with a person, often using text or voice.
The branch of AI focused on helping computers understand and interpret images and video.
A type of machine learning that uses many layers of connected calculations, loosely inspired by how neurons in the brain pass signals, to find patterns in large amounts of data.
dailyChallenge.explanation: A software program designed to hold a conversation with a person, often using text or voice. Chatbots are one of the most common, everyday ways people directly interact with AI today.
